title: How to apply
publisher: The Alignment Project (UK AI Security Institute)
note: Applications through the DSIT Funding Portal; AISI notifies outcomes; payments monthly in arrears; 'The GFA for DSIT/AISI funded projects is standard and not subject to negotiation'; 'Other funders may issue different terms and conditions as part of their GFA'; contact aisialignmentproject@dsit.gov.uk.
